name: BAYHOST/BTHA: Bavaria’s Annual Scholarship Programme
summary: The Bavarian-Czech University Agency (Bayerisch-Tschechische Hochschulagentur) awards annual scholarships, funded by the State of Bavaria, to graduates from the Czech Republic. The scholarship is intended to finance doctoral, postgraduate
